sourceReferencePolicy: City-a, accepted city road-strip-a and farm grass-main-a inspected visually; new-generation calls omit referenced_image_paths. Cues described in prompts.

toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a seamless opaque square ground texture for a colourful, warm painterly mobile city game, final export2048x2048, covering an8x8 metre patch.
Camera: strict orthographic TOP DOWN, looking vertically down. The image itself is a flat material tile, not a perspective scene. North is up, east right. Entire square is filled edge to edge with the material, full opacity.
Style: softly hand-painted game art matching cheerful cream-and-colour town buildings, light warm limestone sidewalks, warm gray asphalt and lively lawns. Soft rounded details, restrained grain, no black outlines and no photoreal noise.
Lighting: diffuse even daylight with only very subtle lower-left/SW surface highlights. No cast shadows of any objects, no vignette, no central spotlight, no directional brightness gradient across the tile.
Tiling: perfectly seamless repeat in BOTH axes; corresponding left/right and top/bottom edges must match in colour, texture scale, orientation and phase. Features crossing an edge continue on the opposite edge. Uniform distribution with no distinct central feature or outer border. Do not draw a sample grid, multiple texture swatches or a frame.
No text, labels, logos, watermarks, objects, props, buildings, road markings, pavement kerbs, dirt paths or perspective.

Material: warm pale beige limestone paving with LARGE regular square slabs in a straight axis-aligned8 by8 grid. Exactly8 whole equal squares across and8 down, narrow soft sandy-beige joints; texture borders lie on the centre of joint lines so adjacent copies create ordinary joints. Full slabs, not cobblestones or bricks. Very subtle natural stone mottling and a few faint warm beige stains, gentle tiny rounded bevels, low contrast joints. Soft cream highlights, warm sand midtones, no heavy dark grout. Keep this suitable next to cream sandstone kerbs and neutral warm gray asphalt. Corners and edge joints match when repeated.
Produce one finished square material image, requested resolution2048x2048.

Gentle painterly variation, densely filled but visually calm, no soil holes, paths, long shadows, large tufts or isolated dark spots. Uniform microdetail and colour on all four tile edges, natural seamless wrap.
